text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 309 Woodmount Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated May 1, 2020, regarding the property located at 309 Woodmount Avenue, Folder No. 19 260862 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2021.
